rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculations with LDA/GGA using a well-known open-source code; no new theory or algorithm; textbook application.
rationale.execution: Requires running multiple DFT codes (pw.x, ph.x) sequentially: geometry relaxation, DFPT phonon at Gamma, q-mesh phonon calculations, and thermodynamic post-processing. Multi-stage pipeline with data extraction and format conversion, though each step is straightforward.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper performs standard DFT/DFPT calculations using Quantum ESPRESSO on a small unit cell (wurtzite BN). The method is textbook, no novel algorithms. The pipeline involves multiple stages but is routine for practitioners. Compute demands are minimal.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small wurtzite unit cell (4 atoms), plane-wave cutoff 55-140 Ry, k-mesh 10x10x10, q-mesh 4x4x4. The calculation is CPU-only and fits easily in a few GB of RAM; no large external datasets besides pseudopotentials.
